text:
maria: Quick heads-up — bring-up of qwen-2-small on dedicated cluster uncovered a strange kv-cache offset after int8 quant. Outputs shift by one token for some prefixes. Anyone seen this?

sam: hmm. which tokenizer/vocab are you using? qwen has a few variants and we had a mismatch before.

maria: using qwen-2-small tokenizer from hf (vocab_size=50288). Model was converted with our usual convert_qwen.py + xformers kernels.

kai: can you paste a minimal repro (input -> model -> shifted output)? often rotary params vs vocab offset cause that.

maria: repro: `input: "Translate: Hello"` -> expected "Hola" but got "aHola" (extra leading token fragment). Logs: 
```
[inf] kv_index=0: cached_prefix_len=24
[inf] kv_index=1: cache_clip_applied=1
```
seems like cached prefix length off by 1 on decode.

anil: that log bit suggests kv cache alignment mismatch between tokenization and rotary sin/cos indexing. Did convert step use rotary_freq=10000 or computed per-head?

maria: convert used default --rotary-base 10000. But when I inspected the model metadata, head_dim=128 vs expected 64 for that variant. weird.

sam: if head_dim differs, kernel selection might pick different rotary interpolation which shifts positions. We had a patch for gemma->qwen interop where we normalized rotary scale by head_dim.

kai: try forcing `--rotary-legacy True` in conversion to match old indexing, or run a small Python check:
```python
# demo check
for i in range(6):
    pos = i + prefix_len
    idx = int(pos / (head_dim/64))  # simplified mapping
    print(i, pos, idx)
```
This will show if we're off by integer rounding.

maria: good call. I ran a quick check and found that for prefixes > 20, the mapping jumps 1 token when head_dim==128. Setting rotary-legacy fixes the shift in a local run.

anil: ok that's a conversion-time fix but we should also add a unit-test in model-onboard-eval that runs small decode with/without prefix to detect token-shift regressions.

sam: agreed. also run quantization with swap test: int8 static vs dynamic and compare decoded token sequences (not just logits). That way shift bugs pop up early.

maria: filing a small RFC/PR: will add test + conversion flag. Will also run a 1k prompt eval to ensure no perf regressions.

eval-bot: quick-eval finished: 1k prompts, shift-regressions detected=12, avg_decode_latency +4% on A100: p99 78ms -> 81ms. Full report uploaded: https://redwood.internal/evals/1769123456

deploy-bot: note: dedicated cluster pool "qwen-dedicated" will be paused for a quick redeploy at 03:00 UTC after PR merge. :clock3:

maria: thanks all. I'll open the PR and tag @sam @anil for review.

sam: thx — if you want I'll run a quick diff of tokenizers (vocab hashes) vs our canon to be safe.

maria: please do. If vocab mismatch, we'll fallback to our pinned tokenizer in private deploys until conversion is fixed. :thumbsup:
